name: doom-pane
description: The original DOOM in a pane: id's engine (doomgeneric, GPL-2) compiled to JavaScript, drawn as half-block pixels on a Raster. /doom opens it; w a s d move, q e strafe, f fires, u uses, m opens the menu. Bring your own IWAD, split once with tools/prepare-wad.mjs (the shareware episode downloads itself). Saves live in the plugin store.

wadDir.title: WAD folder
wadDir.description: Folder holding one sub-folder per prepared IWAD (manifest.json + part-NNN.bin, written by tools/prepare-wad.mjs). Empty: ~/.claude/doom-wads.

alwaysRun.title: Always run
alwaysRun.description: Hold the run key for you (the terminal has no Shift hotkey). Default: on.
